name: Dispute intake with maker-checker approval
description: Pull a card-dispute case from the case-management API, ask an analyst to confirm the provisional credit in the run chat, and post the resolution to the core banking webhook. The workflow is marked requires_approval + elevated so starting any run opens a maker-checker gate.
rationale: Banking template: human-in-the-loop dispute handling under maker-checker governance. requires_approval/elevated gates run-start (a second admin must approve before the run begins, 202 + approval_request); human.prompt adds in-flight analyst confirmation; the core action goes out through the SSRF-guarded webhook.

inputs.message: Review the dispute case above. Approve the provisional credit and chargeback initiation?
